name: Security review
description: Red Team, Blue Team and Compliance threat-model the system, debate controls and produce a ranked security report.
whenToUse: A feature, service or change needs a threat model and a review of its controls and obligations.

texts.severity-scale: High: plausible attack path and serious impact (data exposure, account takeover, outage). Medium: needs an unusual precondition or has limited impact. Low: theoretical or minor.

phases.title: Threat model
phases.goal: Map assets, trust boundaries and threats (Red Team), existing controls (Blue Team) and obligations (Compliance).
instructions: Read the code and configuration in scope before listing threats or controls.

phases.title: Controls
phases.goal: Agree on the severity of each threat and on a proportionate control or an explicit risk to accept.

phases.title: Risk acceptance
phases.goal: Ask the user to accept residual risks or approve controls that need budget.

phases.title: Report
phases.goal: Write the security report and have the Red Team and Compliance confirm it.

triggers: A residual risk must be accepted
A control needs budget, a vendor or a policy change
Whether a regulation applies depends on business facts
